title: Guddu de Karahi
description: Lahore Karahi is an excellent Pakistani restaurant in San Francisco

author: Kasma Loha-unchit
body:
Note: Was Lahore Karahi.

This is the new restaurant by owner-chef Guddu, formerly of Lahore Karahi.

We highly recommend going here for delicious and flavorful Pakistani food: Guddu is a fantastic chef and not afraid of flavor! As all food is meticulously prepared, be sure to leave sufficient time to enjoy the meal.

Note: We previously carried a review of this restaurant from 2004, which removed when Guddu left in 2012. Hopefully we can get another review up sometime soon. I did eat here recently (December 2013) and the food is fantastic: even better than I remember it from before.

In the mean time, here's a S.F. Weekly Review of Guddu de Karahi from December, 2013.
